notes.title: 🇵🇱 Celebrate Polish Constitution Days With Everdream Valley! 🇵🇱
notes.notes:
[h3]🌿 The spring is here, and May 3rd is getting closer and closer - get ready to dive into the vortex of creativity to celebrate Polish gamedev![/h3]

[b]It was the third day of May of the year 1791[/b] when the Polish Constitution was signed. It was a modern constitution seeking to implement wide state reforms, advancing democratization of Poland, and including checks and balances and tripartite separation of powers. It was the first such document in Europe, and the [i]second[/i] in the world, following the American one from 1787. To this day, we're celebrating it as one of the [b]peak[/b] achievements of the [i]Age of Enlightenment[/i] in Poland and the foundations of Polish democracy. 

[hr][/hr]

☀️ While historically, 3 May is a very important holiday, we celebrate it in different ways. We quite often take advantage of the warm sun of May and spring in full bloom, lighting up that grill and gathering for a BBQ ♨️ We can't back this up with any scientific data, but this could be the period when most Polish gamers are finally touching grass!

Of course, each to their own, and if you need to take a break from the sun for a bit so you won't overheat, there are also many ways to celebrate indoors! 🥳

🕹️Once again, [b]Acram Digital[/b] is hosting [b]Polish Constitution Days[/b] on Steam to celebrate the rapidly growing Polish gamedev. There are many titles to choose from, and we're proud that [b]Everdream Valley[/b] is among them! Play it from [b]April 26th to May 3rd[/b] to celebrate the creativity of Polish game creators and check out other games to witness our creativity in its full extent! 🇵🇱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/66e6e02a3fdce0a58c23410bf404583bff82cc19.png[/img]

Sorry for the few-day delay. We’ve been waiting for final patch approvals, but now it’s finally here, yay! 
So to not to keep you waiting, let's get to the patch notes right away!

[u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Owls - your new best friends! They will protect you from mice but they will also help you out with travels! Get 2 owls and you’ll be able to fast travel between their locations! If you have only one owl you will travel back to the farm.
[*] A new breed of sheep will appear in your Valley.
[*] Cutting grass with a sword is fun, but not that effective. Show the grass who’s the boss with the brand new Lawnmower!
[*] Make your farm even prettier with 3 brand-new types of plantable flowers, each featuring 3 unique versions, for a total of 9 different flower styles!
[*] Do you love butterflies? Who doesn’t? You can build a Butterfly House for them now!
[*] A mini-pond for your ducks! You can set up a wooden basin-looking mini pond and put your duck in it! But you know what’s fun? The duck will stay inside of it until it sees a snail. Once a snail is spotted, the duck will jump out, eat the snail and run back into the basin. We call it an “Anti-snail turret”. 
[*] nsect House added - this building will allow you to breed insects - max. 10 per house! Time to relocate? Feel free to catch them with your Bug Net!
[*] Bird House added – Friendly birds will now visit this brand-new building, and in return for the house - they will reward you with various seeds!
[*] Scared of bees? Use the brand-new Turbo Bee Smoker to scare them away for a longer time! 
[*] Added 9 new delicious cooking recipes, yum.
[*] The price of products has been changed, ensuring a better economy.
[*] Added two more saddles for your horses! Enjoy it in green and orange colors. 
[*] You can now build a bonfire which will help you out with keeping the wolves at a distance!
[/list]

Of course, some minor fixes have been added as well, with the goal of making your Everdream experience even better.

Thank you for your support and feedback, keep 'em coming! 🌼

The Everdream Valley Team[/b] 🚜🌟🌱

notes.title: Everdream Valley's Spooky Scarecrow Speaks! 🌾
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey there Farmers, 
it’s the Scarecrow from Everdream Valley here!🌾[/h3] 

You do know me, right? 
I stand there on the farm all year, waiting for [b]THIS DAY[/b] to come. 
🌃 🌇 🌆

Oh, how I love the [b]Spooky Season[/b], and now I get to celebrate it on the farm with all of you! 
This means that… 

🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃   [h3][u][b]THE HALLOWEEN EVENT IS HERE![/b][/u][/h3] 🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃

Yes, yes, yes! 
Look at the colors of the world now, a beautiful golden-toned fall. 
Oh, and some of my friends are joining the farm now. Yay! 

🎃 So all of the fully-grown pumpkins will now turn into [b]Jack-o'-lanterns[/b]! 
🕷️ Also, some [b]eight-legged creatures[/b] are very active during this time. Kick a stone – they’re there, get near some places – they will also be there! I believe humans call them [b]Spiders[/b], I call them fluffy friends with cute eyes. 🕸️
🦇 You’ll also have a chance to spot some majestic [b]Bats[/b], I love the sound of their wings, ahh!

Additionally, I have a pact with wolves during this time of year that you should know about. 
Once all of my team joins the Valley, I send the wolves to go on vacation! 🐺 🌴 ☀️
This way you’re free to explore the land without them chasing you off, you’re welcome :D

You’ll also bump into me right away once you launch the game, and we’ll have a chat about what’s happening in Everdream Valley. [b]I might have a task or two for you… [/b]
But remember, Scarecrows always hold some great rewards for your work. So it will pay off! 

[b]And a few important notices for you, Farmers: [/b]
- if you’re [b]not a fan of Spiders[/b] like I am – you can go to the game's options and [b]turn them into ladybugs![/b] 
- if you [b]do not like my kind of fall coziness, as in the Halloween Event [/b]– you can also [b]turn it off over in the options
[/b]

Have a spooktacular time, Farmers! 
I know I will! 🎃🕯️

[b]P.S. For those who do not like to read between the lines here are the Halloween Event patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] All ripe pumpkins now transform into enchanting custom Halloween models, embracing the spooky spirit!
[*] Kick a stone, and out come the spiders, ready to give you a fright, every single time!
[*] Spiders creep out from under big trees, the corners of buildings, and even the kitchen when you get up close. Watch your step!

notes.title: Q&A with Peter Curleytail 🐷 ❓
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome to the Oink-tastic Frequently Asked Questions session with yours truly, Peter Curleytail! 🐷[/h3]


I'm here to answer all your burning questions and provide you with snout-standing insights into the magical world of Everdream Valley. 
So, let's dive right into the oinkcredible queries and sow some knowledge! 🎊


[h3][b]How do I know when crops need to be watered?[/b][/h3]
[i]Once getting close to the crops, you’ll spot a blue water drop, which means it’s time to water your plants. [/i]

[h3][b]How do I know when crops are fully watered? [/b][/h3]
[i]Start watering your crops, and you’ll notice that the blue water drop mentioned above will disappear. Now your crops can happily grow further! [/i]

[h3][b]How often can I collect animal products, such as wool, milk and eggs?[/b] [/h3]
[i]Each animal produces their own product every three days, so make sure to pay them a visit regularly. [/i]

[h3][b]Where do my items go when my inventory is full? Are they lost for good?[/b] [/h3]
[i]No worries, if your inventory becomes full, then all of the new, collected items will appear in your storage box! You can find it at the barn on your Grandparent’s farm. [/i]

[h3][b]Can my storage box fill all the way up?[/b][/h3]
[i]Nope! The box has unlimited space, once it gets ‘full’, it will expand with additional slots. [/i]

[h3][b]I cannot find the Strawberry and Pumpkin seeds to plant them in order to proceed with my quests. What should I do?[/b][/h3]
[i]Simply grab the Strawberries and Pumpkin and plant them. They will grow and give you even more delicious crops. [/i]

[h3][b]How do I grow trees in the nursery?[/b][/h3]
[i]Build the nursery close to the tree that you want to grow. It will grow a baby one over time! :) 
Just watch out to not to put it too close to a bush, because that’s what will grow in it. Oh, and remember to water your trees too. [/i]

[h3][b]How can I sell my animals?[/b][/h3]
[i]Take a trip to the Merchant, and see what’s there on the list to sell. You can look at the backside of his cart to check it. If you want to sell ducks make sure to follow the quests to unlock a plaque with them, this will unlock the ability to hand them over to the Merchant. [/i]

[h3][b]Will other platforms receive the Steam updates?[/b] [/h3]
[i]Yes, Oink! I’ve heard that the team is working on them, and they all should be appearing soon. Please keep in mind that some of the platforms have a whole submission process, meaning that the updates need to be verified first.[/i]


That’s all for now, but make sure to drop more questions and I will try to answer them in the next session! 

[h3] See you in the Valley!🐷🎮[/h3]

[h3][b]Why do some chicken names disappear by themselves after a few days?[/b][/h3]
[i]This was an issue, and the team has already resolved it! Your chicken’s names should stay in place now.[/i]

[h3][b]Why do the chickens wander off outside the farm when there are grass and hay bales around?[/b][/h3]
[i]Maybe the dog accidentally chased them away? Perhaps it was raining and they were looking for a place to hide? Or they just wanted to go for a walk, they are living animals after all… :) [/i]

[h3][b]What does the total of chicken number mean? For example, it may display Total number of chicken: 12, but the total number in coop is 9. But i don't have any other chicken icons on my map.[/b][/h3]
[i]Trust us - there are 3 more chickens somewhere on the map! :)[/i]

[h3][b]How near or how far apart must the chicken perches be spaced to register as legitimate perches?[/b][/h3]
[i]There is no special distance. It has to be just big enough so that the chicken is able to squeeze into the perch.[/i]

[h3][b]Why does Grandma get stuck in the animal pens that she managed to get into?[/b][/h3]
[i]Check if your fence has any holes in it! If so, then fix it, and this should not be happening :)[/i]

[h3][b]What do ducks eat other than snails?[/b][/h3]
[i]Ducks like to munch on some grass too! [/i]

[h3][b]Why did my trained dog run to the northern island when i went to find the entertaining goats?[/b][/h3]
[i]Perhaps you took a strange route through for example some rocks, which the dog couldn’t climb? Our friend might get lost sometimes, when he cannot find a safe path to go through. [/i]

[h3][b]Are there specific fishing spots? Or we can only catch fish at the pond for the fishing contest?[/b][/h3]
[i]In some of the spots you can see the fish in the water. This means it’s a great place to catch them! [/i]

[i]You need to win a Horse Race Dream! This will unlock a Saddle, which you’ll be able to purchase from the Merchant. [/i]

[h3][b]How do we select one unit of an item/vegetable?[/b][/h3]
[i]There’s no such feature yet, but we’ve added it to our suggestions list! [/i]


That’s all for today folks!

[i]To craft a hay cube you’ll need to have hay in your inventory, then head over to the Workbench and you should find an option to craft it! [/i]

[i]Take out your sword and start cutting some of the fresh grass around you. Some of it should go to your inventory. Grab the freshly cut grass and bring it over to a drying rack, load it up and wait until the grass becomes dry. [/i]

[h3][b]How to make a drying rack?[/b][/h3]
[i]Make sure to follow the quests with Willow! They should unlock the Drying Rack for you. Once you unlock it, head over to the workbench and look it up, it should appear on the list of things you can craft! [/i]

[h3][b]How does teaching the dog work / How to raise the dog's level? [/b][/h3]
[i]Grab a stick and hold it in your hand. The dog should run up to you shortly, then throw it so the dog will start playing fetch with you! You should see the level indicator above your friend’s head go up. Keep playing with your dog until the indicator fills all the way up! [/i]

[h3][b]How does teaching the cat work / How to raise the cat's level?[/b][/h3]
[i]First, you need to find a Cat Toy. Take a closer look around the farmhouse; it should be near! Once you find the toy, simply equip it and wait for the cat to run over to you. Your orange friend should spot the toy and start following it. Now take a closer look at your surroundings; you should see a hoop; if you cannot see it, look underneath your feet; there’s a small yellow arrow indicating the ring's location. Now to the fun part - you need to run up to the hoop and make the cat jump through it! To do so, use the “E” button, or left-click; if the cat is close to the Cat Toy, it will jump up, trying to catch it! Be precise with putting the Toy up near the hoop, and the cat will make the jump! Repeat this process until your pet makes all five jumps. Make sure to pay attention to the time limit! [/i]

[h3][b]Where can I find the old scarf? [/b][/h3]
[i]Look for something blue around the Grandparent’s house! [/i]

[h3][b]How to repair a bridge?[/b][/h3]
[i]Two types of bridges can be repaired with wood, and the other needs nails. If you follow the questlines your Grandparents gave you, you will unlock the necessary nails![/i]

[h3][b]How to get nails?[/b][/h3]
[i]Make sure to follow the quests, and you will unlock them! They may have something to do with a fishing competition that your Grandpa will hold! [/i]

[h3][b]Where do I find bees?[/b][/h3]
[i]Head southwest, and you’ll find a bridge that needs to be repaired with wood. After you pass the bridge, you’ll find that rocks are blocking a path and… the bees you’re looking for! So take out your net and start catching them! [/i]

[h3][b]How to find Willow?[/b][/h3]
[i]Find two things in your inventory - dog treats and Willow’s Bell! Grab the dog treat and feed your precious pet with it, then hold Willow’s Bell and let the dog sniff it; you should see a question mark above its head. Now follow the dog; it will bring you to the cow! [/i]


That’s all for today, folks!

notes.title: Need for Pig!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Diary,[/h3]

I decided to take the initiative in my hands and teach my friend how to ride on my back.

It wasn’t easy! My friend had never ridden on a pig's back before and wasn't sure if it was safe. But I was certain that I am a skilled pig and that it will be just fine.

My friend hopped up onto my back, gripping my bristly fur. We started out slow, with me walking around the farm, carefully balancing my friend on my back. But soon, it got boring and we started to pick up the pace. I am telling you, the speed was there! Paraphrasing the classic - [b]Need for Pig![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/1ee44b7d0e3b17c442f20e0bdc7f51c5bfecb367.png[/img]
It’s not the end of the story, though! We ran through the fields, jumping over obstacles and dodging trees. We soon came across a muddy pond, and I knew what to do. I took a deep breath and charged straight into the mud, My friend holding on tight.

The mud was thick and sticky, and it was a struggle to make our way through. But we were determined to reach the other side. At last, we emerged on the other side of the pond, covered in mud but exhilarated from our adventure. My friend thanked me for such an incredible experience, and I was grinning from ear to ear.

I think we will do it more often and I can’t wait to run around to discover new parts of the farm! 

Have a great day! 

Oink, oink! 
Peter

notes.title: Happy Bee Day!
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy World Bee Day, everyone![/h3]

Today we celebrate the importance of bees in our ecosystem and their crucial role in pollinating our crops and producing honey. Not all bees live in colonies. In fact, most bee species (that is, non-carnivorous wasps) are solitary and are as important to the ecosystem as their domesticated, honey-producing cousins. Indeed, bees are not just buzzing insects, they are essential to our food supply and the overall health of our planet.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/0977defdf2e6ee3eec6430c60e81f6c0050bc63b.png[/img]

On this special day, take a moment to appreciate the hardworking bees that tirelessly collect nectar and pollen to sustain their hives. You can also support bee populations by planting native flowers and avoiding the use of pesticides in your garden.

And of course, what better way to celebrate Bee Day than by enjoying some delicious honey? Whether you drizzle it over your toast or add it to your tea, remember that every drop of honey represents the hard work of thousands of bees!

So let's raise a glass (or a jar of honey) to our fuzzy friends today. 

Happy Bee Day to all! 🍯🐝

notes.title: Peter is collecting fruits!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Diary,[/h3]

What a day! Today I went on a fruit-collecting adventure with my friend.

We started out by exploring the orchard, looking for the juiciest and ripest fruits to collect. Henrietta showed me how to use my snout to gently nudge the apples and pears, testing to see if they were ready to be picked.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/a1f16e3579ed2a2b78ecc151016ee86a6b88c867.png[/img]
Before long, we had a big basket full of fruit. But as we were heading back to the barn, we heard a commotion coming from the other side of the orchard. We cautiously crept towards the noise, and what we found was shocking!

A group of mischievous squirrels had taken over the orchard, and were hoarding all the fruit for themselves! They had climbed up the trees and were chattering and giggling as they gorged on our precious apples and pears.

My friend and I knew we had to do something. We couldn't let those sneaky squirrels get away with all of our fruit! So we hatched a plan.

My friend climbed up onto my back, and together we waddled over to the nearest tree where the squirrels were feasting. I stood on my hind legs and reached as high as I could with my snout, trying to knock down the fruit.

The squirrels just laughed and threw some acorns at us. But soon, they realized we were serious, and they started to retreat. My friend and I worked together to collect as much fruit as we could, and soon we had a full basket once again.

We made our way back to the barn, feeling proud of our victory over the squirrels. It was the most thrilling adventure, and I couldn't have done it without my friend by my side.

See you soon again!
Peter

Now that I know how to use a saw, I can help Grandpa with the farm work. I can build and fix things around the farm, and even help him with chopping wood for the winter. I feel proud of myself and grateful for Grandpa's guidance.

Today was a reminder that we can always learn new things, no matter how old we are or what kind of animal we are. With practice and patience, we can achieve anything we set our minds to!

Peter Curleytail the Pig.

The other day, my friend told me that butterflies are very precious because they have a special way of transforming, they are very pretty, and… hard to catch. I offered that I can catch a few butterflies so that we can admire them together and ask them how it is to be a butterfly.

I figured also that, to catch butterflies you need to move like a butterfly, so I built two wings on my shoulders and moved dancingly and swinged around together with them.

My friend couldn’t stop laughing. I guess I eat a few too many pies to be so light and agile like them… In any case, I tried and tried and danced with butterflies swinging my net around them and I didn’t catch any! I couldn’t understand what I was doing wrong. 

We sat with my friend on the grass and laughed about my wings and dances, at the same time I was sad that I couldn’t make my friend happy.

[b][i]“Hey, you won’t catch us if you force it! We come when we want to! Just come and ask if we have time! Anyway, have a good day!“[/i][/b] said the butterfly and flew off. Those butterflies are really magical!

That was one of the most amazing days I had on the farm, even though we ended up with our catching net empty.

notes.title: Peter is learning how to milk a cow!
notes.notes:
[h2]Oink oink my friends![/h2]
Peter the pig here!

Since I moved to the farm I made a lot of cow friends, they are [b]big[/b] and majestic just like me! So I would visit my friend Willow every day for some chit-chat, and since she's a mom, a cup of fresh milk that I share with her veal! We would talk about life, how pretty are butterflies, and that grandma makes the best pie!

Anyway, today in the morning, when I came, Willow was all sad and tired. She said, "[i]somuuuuubody take muuuu milk please!"[/i] She explained that she is very uncomfortable if she is not giving milk every day, and Grandpa forgot to pay a visit today because the bees needed some cleaning at their house.

[h3]I decided to help Willow but I couldn't do it alone.[/h3] I called my friend for help, and since she knows more than me, she proposed to show me how it is done.

[i]"It's very easy you see"[/i], she said, [i]"all you need is to do one on the right and then on the left. And don't worry if some of the milk doesn't get to the bucket! It's not easy at the beginning!" [/i]

I tried it myself and my friend was right that at the beginning it's very hard to get to the bucket. After few times I eventually understood that it's a matter of rhythm and I got it right!

I know I wasn't an amazing fisherman but now I'm certain that I will be able to help Willow anytime she needs a hand with getting the milk. She was very happy! I am as well because eventually, I found something that I can do well.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/6677857a3af149728e86fdd1938a1a4a57cc018f.gif[/img]


Anyway, it was an oink day my friends!
See you soon!

notes.title: Peter Curleytail is going fishing!
notes.notes:
[h3]We're going fishing with my favourite human![/h3]

I always knew that I was somewhat of a fisherpig myself, and so, [i]oink[/i], I'm oh so happy to have the chance to learn how to fish! 

I wonder what kind of aquatic friend I could make!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/aa2d11791061df300c2f7f08fdd61042f919fdfc.png[/img]

We made fish traps with an old pair of jeans that we sewed shut at one end with a bit of fishnet, and attached some cotton thread on a bamboo stick to make a fishing rod. 

My friend told me that to be a good fisherman all you need is to be patient. We attached the traps in the water, threw the rods, and we waited. And we waited. The sky was blue, and the clouds were passing by.

After a very long time, I had enough of waiting and I wanted to meet my first fish! That fishing rod thing was making no sense, I jumped in the water to find a fish myself!

Oh, the water was cold! I didn't like it at all. I run out of it as fast as I got in and run straight to a nice little mud pond next to me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/a3486c2928faea2a4d8833015cb4436f92aafa60.png[/img]

My friend came back and she was surprised: "I left for only 5 minutes!" she said. What? It's been at least two hours already!

We laughed and decided that maybe fishing was not exactly for me.
One day I'll speak to a real whale from the river!

[b]I wonder what adventures await me next! Have a good day friends![/b]

notes.title: Peter Curleytail's Shearing Shenanigans
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Diary, Peter Curleytail the pig here again![/h3]

I have to tell you about the most amazing adventure I had today on the farm. I thought I had seen it all, but today was truly a woolly whirlwind!

So, I was exploring the farm with my human friend when we stumbled upon a group of sheep. They seemed a bit restless and, dare I say, itchy. They kept rubbing themselves against trees and fences. My human friend told me they were due for a shave!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/9c3f19ad66ac2f027540828690e2e4b6b5b4ae82.png[/img]

I was so curious, I just had to watch. My human friend grabbed a pair of shears and started gently shaving the sheep. I must admit, at first, I was a little worried about their safety, but my friend assured me that the shearing process was not only safe, but necessary for the sheep's health and comfort. As the wool came off, the sheep seemed to feel lighter and happier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/f34fcab6b2015ccc864b71bb8a33c170db78b815.gif[/img]

After the shearing was complete, my human friend showed me all the beautiful wool we had collected. They told me that this wool would be used to create cozy blankets, stylish clothing, and even soft toys for the little ones. I couldn't help but feel a sense of pride in our accomplishment.

So I've decided to become a shaving assistant! Of course, with my hooves, I won't be able to hold the shears myself, but I'll be there for moral support and to help gather the wool. Maybe one day, I'll even have my own woolly creation to snuggle up in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/04f125f837d2a11d28e441aefd7517bd99b4b07e.png[/img]

Until then, I'll be practicing my shearing skills and learning everything there is to know about our fluffy friends. Oink oink!

---

[i]Stay woolly,
Peter Curleytail and your farming and shearing team from Mooneaters, VARSAV, and Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Peter Curleytail is baking bread
notes.notes:
[h2]Today we were baking bread with my human friend![/h2]

We first had to get me clean, and to my disappointment, it wasn't a mud bath. We then added the sourdough starter from yesterday's bread to the flour and a bit of salt. My human lady gave me my own piece of dough, hard to knead with those tough hooves!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYTk2MWFkNzIxMzdjOTU4ZGIwYWEzNjdiYzRmNTg3MDk5ZjAzNTQxMSZjdD1n/cpf78JpVHdQTrCLMQe/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

I must admit that with this amount of funky goodness being so close to my nose, everything had to end up in my stomach, which made her laugh very much. I'm good at what I'm doing, what can I say?

She then fired up the oven while her dough was rising. When it was blazing hot, she put it on a baking tray on her own (again, hoof problem), and we waited glued to the door, watching as the dough rose and cracked, and the loaf slowly obtained a beautiful golden colour.

I must admit that this made me quite hungry, and I munched on a few courgette peels from
the compost bin. What a loaf when it came out, rounded and chubby like me!

We devoured it with a double serving of strawberry jam and many celebratory noises,
as educated piggies like me know how to do, oink oink!

Cannot wait for the next one tomorrow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/750569091b11e75e1445c4b8ef256f06e0fd3961.png[/img]

[h2]Oh wait, don't go just yet![/h2]

Dear reader, I [u][b]have to[/b][/u] share with you the recipe we followed for three crunchy baguettes:
- 300g of water
- 2 teaspoons of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 490g of flour
- 2.5 teaspoons of dry yeast

Knead everything together for 20min. Preheat your oven to 240C. Cut 3 balls from your dough, and form the baguettes with it. Lay them on parchment paper, make 2 cuts with a sharp knife on each,
spray them with milk and cook them for 25min.

That's it!

Enjoy!

---

[i]Peter Curleytail and your farming and cooking team from Mooneaters, VARSAV and Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Weird adventures at the Everdream farm!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Diary, Peter Curleytail the pig here![/h3]

Today something extraordinary happened. It has been a few weeks since I arrived at the farm and I must… [i]oink oink[/i]… admit that some of the local customs are pretty peculiar!

So we went today to the local merchant that I like so much. He always gives me a treat when nobody looks… it’s really tasty… [i]oink![/i] Anyway, so we are going around with our usual business but then I noticed that in the camping of the merchant, there are a lot of hens sitting around with their eggs. 

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/758405478484672542/1091752328350142575/Asset_7.png[/img]

I rushed towards them to say hello. And they all screamed, “[i]cluck cluck[/i]”. One started - “[i]I am such a chick, oh wow, you probably never saw such a real chick before…hihih[/i]”. Why did she laugh? I wondered… They were all staring at me very excitedly. Another one said, “[i]Yeeees, I love to sit on my egg, this is [b]suuuuche[/b] a normal behaviour![/i]”

I started to think that those chicks are very odd. But what can I know… I am a piggy, I 
don’t know much about the chicken stuff.

Suddenly they all started to laugh very loud but. They didn’t sound like chicks at all! They all screamed “[i]Prima Aprillis![/i]” and took off their costumes. They were all ducks! I couldn’t believe my eyes! Why did ducks dress up as chicks?

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/758405478484672542/1091752328622776331/Asset_6.png[/img]

I thought “[i]Prima oink?![/i]” … I mean… “[i]Prima what?![/i]”. On top of that, my friend rushed in and screamed [i]“Happy Halloween![/i]”. She was wearing a pumpkin on her head! “[i]But… but… Halloween is in Autumn and we have April now[/i]” I mumbled.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/758405478484672542/1091752328912191578/Asset_5.png[/img]

Ohh I was certain I was losing my mind, maybe I shouldn’t have eaten that many berries this morning… Everybody was laughing. I rushed to the merchant to ask him what is going on. He explained that in the farm tradition, the 1st of April is April’s Fools Day. On that day everybody makes jokes and tries to make some funny pranks.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/758405478484672542/1091752329193197770/Asset_4.png[/img]

That was surprising! I mean, such an odd custom! But you know what, dear diary, I will make the greatest jokes on the farm next year! I will dress up as a lamb or say that I love carrots! Good that I have the whole year to think of something![i] Oink, oink![/i] 

[b]Anyway, it’s getting late[/b], I think I will take a nap now… I heard that we will have some cherries for dinner…

notes.title: How to use eletricity to water your crops
notes.notes:
In Everdream Valley, there is more than one way to water your crops. You're a fan of running with a watering can? No problem, but if you want to harness wind energy and automate your watering, that's an option too.

[previewyoutube=IP3TV2qlDZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everybody!


Today we will introduce you to different systems of watering plants. Let's start with the fact that on your farm you can focus on different activities like raising animals doing story quests and exploring or growing crops. Plants, however, need water to grow.
 

If growing plants is just an additional task, you will only need a few beds and a watering can or water bottle. You can fill them in a well or any other body of water.

However, if you decide to farm large tracts of land, then you could use some automation. 

To set up an automatic irrigation system you will need several things:

[list]
[*] a water pump
[*] a wind turbine
[*] garden hose
[*] electric cables
[*] bunch of garden sprinklers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/c44c0b56e555710c3b247d808fd21c67cf1115dd.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] The water pump can be set up at any water body.
[*] Then with the help of electrical wires, you need to connect it to the wind turbine.
[*] The next step will be to set up the garden sprinklers in the areas that you want them to be watered.
[*] Finally, you connect the sprinklers to the pump using a garden hose and voila! electricity has arrived on your farm.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/1980bbcfb69d5c5a85664acb2cca28b6242b0a9f.jpg[/img]

Both the electric wires and the garden hose are counted in meters so you can run them all over the farm.


Of course, you can also count on rain to quench the thirst of your plants as well as watering cans or sprinklers. However, it does not rain often enough, so in that case, you will have to wait a little longer for your crops.

When it rains your crops can also be attacked by snails, but more on that in the next post!

notes.title: How do you make friends with a cat?

And why is it worth it? Besides the undeniable pleasure of having a fluffy orange companion, making a friendship with a cat in Everdream Valley has some very practical implications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/4aa8ca4faa4ae304b1bb4bf00f0365376a3fe623.png[/img]

- Will chase away birds, rats, and other pests if it sees them near your crops.
- Will help you with some of your storyline tasks.
- Provides you with a lot of entertainment while you explore the valley.

[previewyoutube=GsBvy-_yMY0;full][/previewyoutube]

All these things the cat will do only if you are friends with it.
To get your cat to like you, you must, first of all, take the time to keep him entertained and play cat agility with him using a cat toy. To increase the level of your cat's friendship, you have to lead him through a series of obstacles within a certain time. notes.title: Things you can do in the Countryside!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/aa046b7fc8126326804de356e4f8aec18d4219a6.png[/img]

Dear Summer Diary,

I didn't know that life on the farm can be sooooo exhausting! Since I got here I'm super busy learning how to look after animals or farm. Grandpa says, I was born for this, but I'm not sure. My crops are not so magnificent as his. And there is one horse in the stable, that bites me every time. Maybe I should bring him a carrot next time? 
Well, since you got here, I will tell you what I've learned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/8550cbe3b8aff55ff17122df0875dc7095c7569c.png[/img]

[b]Herding sheep[/b]

"You have to ensure the safety of your flock" - grandpa says. And if you don't want your sheep to get hurt, you have to herd them home. It's not easy, but you can learn it. You can prepare a loong stick, so you look like a magician, but you don't have to. It's also easier with the dog. My dog always helps me. You have to run where sheep shouldn't go. And that's it. 

[b]Catching butterflies [/b]

Oh, that's really fun. Grandma gave me a butterfly net. And catching is easy! But... characterizing them is not a piece of cake. Don't worry! I've prepared a special book with every species. You can use that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/85830cc0e08ca7c2755ce8e48a8f3756a5c07573.png[/img]

[b]Ducks Enticement[/b]

Apparently, ducks love snails. If you collect some of them, you can throw them behind and they will follow you! Funny thing, isn't it? 
And those little ducklings! So cute!


Would you like to see more countryside activities? 
Let me know!
